summary: The official Punjab cadastral MapServer was followed from the current PULSE viewer configuration. Pakpattan layer 26 returned one exact-WUP-point polygon with native OBJECTID 14255244 and EPSG:3857/102100 source CRS. No retained sample was written; runtime remains held.
queryAndRequestOutcomes: Separate English and Urdu discovery queries, viewer GET, anonymous no-token service GET, transient public viewer-token fetch, service/layer metadata requests, and a bounded exact-point GeoJSON query were executed. Full route outcomes are recorded in city-7986-arifwala.json.
cityOrLocalCustodian: Punjab Land Records Authority/PULSE is the first-party provincial service; the Municipal Committee Arifwala page is the local administrative custodian evidence. The parcel response itself is from the official provincial Pakpattan cadastral layer.
routesAttempted: See city-7986-arifwala.json requests. No login, credentials, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, private token, unsafe lookup, or TLS-verification disablement was used.
schemaAndCrs: Verified layer 26 is Polygon; service/layer metadata reports EPSG:3857/ArcGIS WKID 102100. Query output was requested as GeoJSON in EPSG:4326.

geometryDecision.exactWupPointTest: One polygon returned for the exact WUP point [30.2910073270847,73.0632724019758]; no coordinate shift.
